title: Infografía Comparativa: Características del Shiba Inu, Pastor Alemán y Bulldog Francés
prompt: I am considering getting a pet dog but am still struggling to choose a breed. Please help me generate an infographic that centrally displays the characteristics, temperament, common health issues, and feeding guide for the following potential breeds: Shiba Inu, German Shepherd, French Bulldog. The infographic needs to be clear and easy to compare.
